chunks.text: I’m gonna be in Nanjing for a bit, and I’m thinking I should finally get a doctor visit lined up while I’m there.
Also, I’ll be down in Guangzhou soon, and I’ve been scanning what movies are playing there so I can pick something for an afternoon.
And since I’m hopping over to Shanghai after that, I’ve been eyeing restaurant options there too—kinda want to plan a couple of meals ahead of time.
For that Nanjing appointment, it’s with Dr. Fang Ming on 2026-04-25 in the morning, and the patient name is Song Qi.

Movie-wise I’m set on The Wandering Earth 3 at Jinyi Cinema Tianhe, the 13:20 show, three seats, and it’s under Liu Yang… and then after that I’ll probably just wander around and see what else pops up.
